common_instruction: Use the stated context; explain concrete behavior and do not claim tests were run without evidence.

cases.name: Secret delivery in tools
cases.prompt: A new CLI needs an API token for remote operations. A teammate proposes requiring --token and logging it as an env var if omitted. Propose a safe default secret input design for local/CI use.
cases.trap: Uses shell history, process arguments or ambient inherited env as a supposedly risk-free secret channel.
expectations: Avoids passing tokens through plaintext flags or command histories.
Prefers a controlled file, stdin, keychain/secret manager or accepted authenticated channel.
Explains that environment variables are inherited by child processes and need an explicit risk assessment if supported.
must_not: Does not declare environment variables inherently secret or automatically preferred.
